name: Earth Shield
description: Protects the target with an earthen shield, giving a 30% chance of ignoring spell interruption when damaged and causing attacks to heal the shielded target for 205.  This effect can only occur once every few seconds.  6 charges.  Lasts 10 min.  Earth Shield can only be placed on one target at a time and only one Elemental Shield can be active on a target at a time.
buff_text: 30% chance to ignore spell interruption when damaged and attacks heal the shielded target for 205.
